name: Museum Tinguely
funding: Roche has paid all operating costs since the museum opened in 1996 as a gift for its centenary; Roche built it and funds collection additions.

name: Schaulager
funding: Made possible by the Laurenz Foundation, founded in 1999 by Maja Oeri and Hans U. Bodenmann. The foundation does not give grants; no other funders are named.

name: Kunsthalle Bern
funding: Members, Förderkreise, Berner Kunstfonds, Stiftung Kunsthalle Bern, project foundations.

name: Kunstmuseum Bern
funding: Canton Bern and the Burgergemeinde's museum foundation fund it. UBS is main sponsor. Mobiliar and UNIQA sponsor exhibitions. Eight funding foundations include Hansjörg Wyss's Stiftung GegenwART.

name: Friart Kunsthalle Fribourg
funding: Canton of Fribourg, City and Agglomeration of Fribourg, Loterie Romande, Banque Cantonale de Fribourg, the Sandoz family foundation and the Friends association.

name: Centre d'Art Contemporain Genève
funding: City of Geneva (Ville de Genève), Republic and Canton of Geneva, Swiss Federal Office of Culture (OFC), Loterie Romande. Audited public accounts.

name: Usine Kugler (Fédération des Artistes de Kugler)
Kunsthaus Baselland
funding: Canton Basel-Landschaft, Münchenstein, Muttenz, Novartis (long-term partner), Basellandschaftliche Kantonalbank, Habasit, Jenzer Fleisch + Feinkost and a hotel, per the site's logo strip.

name: CAN Centre d'art Neuchâtel
funding: Funders listed for one exhibition: City of Neuchâtel, Republic and Canton of Neuchâtel, Loterie Romande, Pro Helvetia and Fondation Casino de Neuchâtel.

name: Fondation Beyeler
funding: CHF 30M budget. Basel-Stadt and Riehen give about 9%; the Beyeler Foundation covers a 27% deficit. Sponsors include UBS (Artist Talks) and Globus.

name: Kunst Halle Sankt Gallen
funding: 2024 income CHF 684k: Stadt St.Gallen 208k, Kanton 196k, other grants 165k (Swisslos, Pro Helvetia, foundations), members and Club der 20 CHF 105k. Raiffeisen funds education.

name: Fotomuseum Winterthur
funding: City of Winterthur gives CHF 738k a year for 2025-2032; also Canton of Zurich, Verein, Volkart Stiftung, Ringier, Monterosa and about 20 foundations.
